issues.legal_issue: A court may extend the time to pay the balance consideration under a decree for specific performance, but must exercise that discretion judicially in light of the parties’ conduct and the circumstances of the delay.
An unexplained delay of 853 days in seeking an extension to pay the balance consideration does not justify extending the time for payment under a decree for specific performance.

When the decree-holder fails to pay the balance consideration within the prescribed period and does not establish grounds for extending the time, the agreement may be rescinded under Section 28 of the Specific Relief Act.
